source: User-supplied ruler readings in the assessment conversation, after model and test results were frozen.

envelope.ruler_description: Centimetre-marked scale: nine intermediate ticks between 0 and 1 cm, so ten intervals of 1 mm.

checkerboard.reading_context: Reply to the request for the total length of five consecutive squares horizontally and vertically.

limits: One physical envelope measured once and matched to 70 original photo trials.
No new physical object or fresh capture was added by reusing this reading.
The scale division is 1 mm. Repeatability and alignment uncertainty were not measured; no sub-millimetre ground-truth precision is claimed.
